schemaDoc.purpose: Single source of truth for what is verified, observed or merely inferred across the SportsDesk/Fantasy402 docs release. P2 (spec generator) and P3 (markdown generator) must consume this instead of re-asserting contracts.

operationFields.path: Exact path string from docs/openapi.json (47 paths, 48 operations).
operationFields.method: Lowercase HTTP method as in the spec.
operationFields.operationId: Spec operationId, or null where the spec omits it.
operationFields.tier: A | B | C | E for operations. D is reserved for surfaces[] rows (real surfaces absent from the spec), so counts.D is 0 by construction.
operationFields.capturedResponse: true only when a real captured response body exists in the repo or GS extract. False for every row in this release.
operationFields.evidence[]: Array of {source, kind, note}. source conventions in sourcePrefixes; source 'none' means no artifact exists.
operationFields.requiredCapture: The exact capture (or implementation) that would upgrade the row.
operationFields.contradicted: true when a spec assertion is refuted by a concrete artifact; contradictedReason carries the quotes.
operationFields.candidate_url: true when the path+method is a candidate inferred from UI/DOM metadata rather than observed on the wire.
operationFields.ui_observed: true when a UI/DOM artifact exists for the operation.

surfaceFields.id: Stable id; every id appears verbatim in docs/EVIDENCE.md.
surfaceFields.name: Human label.
surfaceFields.tier: D = real surface missing from the spec; E = documented operation with no implementation.
surfaceFields.missingFromSpec: true when docs/openapi.json has no row for this surface.

schemaDoc.counts: Operation counts by tier. A+B+C+D+E = total = 48. Surface counts are in surfaceCounts and are not mixed into counts.
schemaDoc.countsByTag: Operation tier counts per spec tag (convenience for P2/P3).

sourcePrefixes.(no prefix): Path relative to the worktree root /Users/nolarose/code/sportsdesk-ops/.worktrees/docs.
sourcePrefixes.main:: Read-only main tree /Users/nolarose/code/sportsdesk-ops (never edited by this task).
sourcePrefixes.fixture:: Committed fixture under the worktree; a shape sample, not a wire capture.

tierRules.A: Captured wire contract: a real request AND a real response capture exist. Nothing in this release qualifies (the only HAR captured requests and request headers, never response bodies).
tierRules.B: Observed first-party evidence. (i) captured wire request: getWebLog mode B and getInfoPlayer (2026-10-28 Manager HAR); (ii) observed request payload: GS getBetReport; or (iii) a route this repository serves, verified against its handler source (GET /health, GET /api/watchlist, POST /api/telegram/alert, POST /api/telegram/report). Response bodies may still be uncaptured.
tierRules.C: Inferred only. Authored in docs/openapi.json or its generator scripts, or a repo TypeScript wire type, or a UI/DOM observation whose URL+method is a candidate. No request or response was observed.
tierRules.D: A real surface missing from the spec. Recorded in surfaces[], never in operations[].
tierRules.E: Documented operation with no implementation in this repository (/api/desk/*).
tierRules.crawlerCandidatesRule: B-vs-C rule for the 11 'Tracked Operational Domains' candidates (gameAdmin, getMessages, adjustBalance, createPlayer, get3rdPartyLimits, getAnalysis, getScores, getAgentTree, getBilling, getRules, getFinancialReport): a launcher tile alone is not enough for B. B requires a URL+method observed on the wire (or a handler that serves it). Those 11 rows take their path+method from hand-authored candidateEndpoint/candidateMethod constants in main:scripts/portal_tile_crawler.ts:40-162, echoed by main:scripts/append_tracked_domains.mjs:22-228. The crawler CLI entry runs the OFFLINE_SIMULATION branch (main:scripts/portal_tile_crawler.ts:168) and its live branch only replaces extracted inputs/L-keys, never the URL/method; no audit JSON or screenshot proof exists in the main tree. They are therefore tier C with candidate_url=true and ui_observed=true, never B. getAnalysis and getFinancialReport also have independent UI action-name evidence (runbook:166-167), which improves the tile evidence but does not observe the URL.

surfaces.name: Fantasy402 sport catalog
surfaces.what: Desk navigation reference: 19 sports, 230 sub-sports, 42 period menus, 2 desk-link collision ids (Arena -> Football + Horse Racing; NCAA Extra -> Basketball + Hockey), 4 provenance digests (subSportTree, periodMenus, collisionRegistry, expectedEmptyPaths). capturedAt 2026-10-21T16:38:53.513Z; periodsCapturedAt 2026-10-30T04:59:14.572Z.

evidence.note: Fixture declares provider fantasy402, capturedAt 2026-10-21T16:38:53.513Z, sportCount 19, subSportCount 230, periodsCapturedAt 2026-10-30T04:59:14.572Z, sportPeriodCount 42; computed values match the declared counts.
PINNED_EXPECTED_EMPTY_SUBSPORT_PATHS: stable Football/Coll Ext, Hockey/NCAA Extra, Horse Racing/Arena, Soccer/France Ligue; volatile LIVE/MMA Live, LIVE/WNCAA Live.
makeDeskLinkId: collision codes become '<Sport>|<code>' keys, closing over the collision registry.
CatalogDigestSet defines the 4 sha256 digests and computeProvenanceDigests hashes the stable-JSON views.
validateFantasy402SportCatalog enforces declared counts, per-sport duplicate codes, period numbering (0..n-1 with period 0 named Game), timestamp ordering and expected-empty paths.

surfaces.note: The fixture is a committed sample used as SSOT for tests, not a raw wire capture. Its capturedAt values are fixture-declared; no HAR or export artifact backs them. The catalog is absent from docs/openapi.json.

evidence.note: resolveHistoryPollUrl builds `${base}/cloud/api/Manager/getHistory` from SPORTSDESK_PORTAL_HTTP_BASE; pollManagerGetHistory POSTs with no body, 60s timeout, accepts array or {data:[]}.

surfaces.name: /api/desk/* routes documented with no implementation
surfaces.what: 9 spec paths / 10 operations under /api/desk/* (auth session POST+DELETE, auth/me, hitl approve/queue/reject, forensics audit/scores, rfq quote/hedge) have no handler, no HMAC verifier, no CookieMap session code and no queue store anywhere in the repo.
